acceptance_checks.current_desktop_platform: Electron desktop app in apps/stage-tamagotchi, confirmed by Electron main code, electron-vite, and electron-builder configuration.
runtime_boundaries_identified: Electron main process and injeca-owned services
Widgets renderer to sandboxed extension iframe via window-message Eventa
Main-owned loopback HTTP static-asset server with cookie-backed asset sessions
Godot child-process sidecar, MCP stdio child processes, and server-runtime WebSocket server
Prospective per-plugin Node child processes and an independent remote daemon/control-client boundary

documentation_drift.claim: The plugin architecture documentation describes a Node Plugin Host with embedded, external Node, and remote deployment modes.
documentation_drift.implementation_evidence: apps/stage-tamagotchi/src/main/services/airi/plugins/host/index.ts constructs ExtensionHost in Electron main, and apps/stage-tamagotchi/src/main/index.ts wires it into injeca.

documentation_drift.claim: Multi-transport plugin contexts are designed for WebSocket, worker, and Electron transports.
documentation_drift.implementation_evidence: packages/plugin-sdk/src/plugin-host/runtimes/node/index.ts:24-35 implements only in-memory context creation and throws for WebSocket, node-worker, and Electron transports.

documentation_drift.claim: Capability orchestration is a host/instance/predicate-based dependency graph.
documentation_drift.implementation_evidence: packages/plugin-sdk/src/plugin-host/runtimes/shared/services/dependencies.ts:16-119 is a key-based in-memory registry with readiness waiters, not the proposed scoped graph.

rationale: The review is evidence-backed, distinguishes current Electron implementation from planned documentation, compares three viable deployment shapes, and gives reversible migration and failure-oriented verification criteria. All nine dimensions are covered without material factual errors or unresolved decision-relevant documentation conflicts.
